falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4200 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 75% bottom pattern match, as the structural support level defining that bottom would have failed

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent extreme fear readings contradict the 'bottom' signal; the 2024 August bottom featured VIX peaking near 28 and rapidly declining, so sustained elevation above 35 indicates this is not a comparable bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further below -75bps (currently approx -15 to -25bps range)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal escalating recession probability rather than the soft-landing/goldilocks conditions that characterized the August 2024 bottom, breaking the macroeconomic similarity required for the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
